name: 17057 · Middletown, PA
findings: ZIP 17057 (Middletown) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17057 (Middletown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17057 (Middletown) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
